UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public forum member profile without PII.

profileDetailsPublic.description: Whether the account owner chose to display profile stats and bio publicly.

verificationBadge.description: Account verification tier assigned by platform administrators.

accountStatus.description: Account moderation state; suspended accounts cannot perform any actions.

suspendedReason.description: Optional reason shown when an account is suspended by the platform owner.

suspendedRuleNumber.description: Community rule number (1-13) violated when suspended.

UserFollower.title: UserFollower
UserFollower.description: Record of a forum member following another member.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Private user account information (PII isolated from public reads).

Topic.title: Topic
Topic.description: A discussion topic posted by a verified forum member.

title.description: Required >= 5 chars unless posting an image-only Kijiweni post.

body.description: Required >= 10 chars unless posting an image-only Kijiweni post.

images.description: Up to 300 ordered Cloudinary HTTPS image URLs for multi-photo Kijiweni posts.

bodyFontStyle.description: Optional author-selected typography style for Kijiweni post descriptions.

Reply.title: Reply
Reply.description: A reply inside a discussion topic.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: Single-user upvote record preventing duplicate voting.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: Safety moderation report for spam, harassment, or misinformation.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A real-time community group chat message with optional image or document attachment.

deletedForUids.description: UIDs of users who deleted this message for themselves only.

MchartNote.title: MchartNote
MchartNote.description: Structured community study/announcement note published by the platform owner inside Mchart.

MchartNoteContent.title: MchartNoteContent
MchartNoteContent.description: Protected full body and PDF URL of a locked Mchart note, readable only by unlocked/paid members and owner.

MchartNoteAccess.title: MchartNoteAccess
MchartNoteAccess.description: Per-user unlock, pending payment confirmation, or specific lock status for an Mchart note.

MemberIdRecord.title: MemberIdRecord
MemberIdRecord.description: Registered official Malosha Forums member ID card & security serial record for anti-fake verification (zero PII).

UserPresence.title: UserPresence
UserPresence.description: Real-time online presence and Mchart typing indicator state per member (zero PII).

MemberDirectoryEntry.title: MemberDirectoryEntry
MemberDirectoryEntry.description: Zero-PII public member directory entry used for alphabetical A-Z member discovery and Private Chat search.

UserNotification.title: UserNotification
UserNotification.description: Facebook-style real-time reply and comment notification stored privately per recipient user.

ruleNumber.description: Violated community rule number (1-13) for moderation alerts.

DirectChat.title: DirectChat
DirectChat.description: Private WhatsApp-style 1-on-1 direct conversation strictly restricted to its two participants.

blockedByUids.description: Optional list of participant UIDs (max 2) who blocked this 1-on-1 conversation.

DirectChatMessage.title: DirectChatMessage
DirectChatMessage.description: End-user private 1-on-1 message readable only by the two participants of the direct chat.

participants.description: Exactly 2 participant UIDs matching parent thread.

deletedForUids.description: UIDs of participants who deleted this message for themselves only.

MchartStatus.title: MchartStatus
MchartStatus.description: 24-hour WhatsApp-style ephemeral photo or video status with strict audience privacy.

allowedViewerIds.description: Up to 50 permitted viewer UIDs when privacy is selected.

MchartStatusView.title: MchartStatusView
MchartStatusView.description: Status view receipt readable strictly by the status author and the viewer themselves.

VideoPost.title: VideoPost
VideoPost.description: TikTok-style short vertical video or photo-with-music carousel uploaded to Cloudinary by a verified member.

photoUrls.description: Up to 10 Cloudinary HTTPS image URLs for photo carousel posts.

VideoComment.title: VideoComment
VideoComment.description: Comment or threaded/auto reply on a TikTok-style post.

SiteNavSettings.title: SiteNavSettings
SiteNavSettings.description: Owner-controlled navigation visibility settings (e.g. hiding Video or Mpoll tab for non-admin users).

ContentRetentionSettings.title: ContentRetentionSettings
ContentRetentionSettings.description: Owner-controlled automated retention & sequential cleanup policy for Kijiweni and Video posts.

PlatformLockSettings.title: PlatformLockSettings
PlatformLockSettings.description: Owner-controlled global platform lock status with stated reason and email recovery tracking.

OwnerCustomIdCard.title: OwnerCustomIdCard
OwnerCustomIdCard.description: Owner-only editable specimen identity card matching the Tanzania citizen ID layout.

TrainingCertificate.title: TrainingCertificate
TrainingCertificate.description: Owner-issued A4 institutional training certificate with anti-counterfeit watermarks and serial verification.

OwnerPrivatePhoto.title: OwnerPrivatePhoto
OwnerPrivatePhoto.description: Owner-only private personal photo vault backup record with SHA-256 content deduplication.

OwnerPhotoFolder.title: OwnerPhotoFolder
OwnerPhotoFolder.description: Owner-only nested private photo vault folders with optional SHA-256 PIN protection.

Poll.title: Poll
Poll.description: Community poll, social vote, or candidate election with configurable styles, security settings, and visibility.

options.description: 0 options for open_opinion discussion questions, or up to 50 poll option/candidate objects.

optionIds.description: Matching option ID strings for rule validation (empty for open_opinion).

PollTournament.title: PollTournament
PollTournament.description: Multi-stage deterministic knockout leader elimination process (e.g., 2-500 candidates narrowed step-by-step via votes with optional gender quotas).

PollComment.title: PollComment
PollComment.description: Facebook-style threaded comment or reply under an Mpoll discussion question.

PollBallot.title: PollBallot
PollBallot.description: Single-account immutable-identity ballot record preventing duplicate voting.

selectedOptionIds.description: 1 to 50 selected option IDs chosen by the voter.

ChatFileMeta.title: ChatFileMeta
ChatFileMeta.description: Metadata for Mchart chat documents and Slide PDFs stored directly in Firestore.

ChatFileChunk.title: ChatFileChunk
ChatFileChunk.description: Base64 binary chunk belonging to a ChatFileMeta document.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Private PII document (docId='info') isolated to owner and admin.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: Private Facebook-style reply and comment notifications for a recipient user.

/users/{userId}/followers/{followerId}.description: Real-time follower records for a forum member.

/topics/{topicId}/votes/{userId}.description: Per-user upvote records on a topic.

/topics/{topicId}/replies/{replyId}/vote.description: Per-user upvote records on a reply.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Content safety reports submitted by verified users.

/mchart_notes/{noteId}.description: Public and private formatted notes/slides created by owner or members, with owner lock/payment/delete governance.

/mchart_notes/{noteId}/content/{docId}.description: Protected full body and PDF link (docId='full') for paid/locked Mchart notes.

/mchart_notes/{noteId}/access/{userId}.description: Per-user payment unlock and specific lock access control records.

/member_ids/{cardId}.description: Official member ID card registry used by platform owner to verify ID authenticity.

/member_directory/{userId}.description: Zero-PII active member directory entries for alphabetical A-Z member discovery and Private Chat search.

/user_presence/{userId}.description: Real-time online presence and Mchart typing status for active members.

/direct_chats/{chatId}.description: Private 1-on-1 conversation threads accessible strictly to the two participants.

/direct_chats/{chatId}/messages/{message.description: Private 1-on-1 messages accessible strictly to the two chat participants.

/mchart_statuses/{statusId}.description: 24-hour ephemeral WhatsApp-style photo and video statuses visible only to signed-in permitted members.

/mchart_statuses/{statusId}/views/{viewe.description: Per-viewer receipt for a status, listable only by the status owner.

/mchart_group_reads/{userId}.description: Group chat per-user read cursors powering accurate gray vs blue read ticks and Message Info.

/site_settings/{settingId}.description: Platform navigation visibility (navigation), Mchart group config (mchart_group), stats (community_stats), retention schedules (retention), and global owner platform lock (platform_lock).

/owner_id_cards/{cardId}.description: Owner-only editable specimen identity card configurations.

/owner_private_photos/{photoId}.description: Owner-only private personal photo vault backup records with SHA-256 deduplication.

/owner_photo_folders/{folderId}.description: Owner-only hierarchical folders for organizing and locking private photos.

/polls/{pollId}.description: Community polls & voting cards creatable by signed-in non-suspended members, readable publicly (open/closed), manageable by creator or admin (with atomic ballot count increment).

/polls/{pollId}/tallies/{optionId}.description: Per-option vote counter protected by resultsVisibility rules and atomic ballot diff checks.

/polls/{pollId}/ballots/{userId}.description: Authenticated single-account ballot record preventing duplicate votes.

/polls/{pollId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Facebook-style threaded opinion comments under an Mpoll question.

/polls/{pollId}/comments/{commentId}/lik.description: Per-user like records on Mpoll discussion comments.

/poll_tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Multi-stage deterministic elimination elections linked to Mpoll ballot rounds.

/chat_files/{fileId}.description: Metadata for Mchart PDFs and chat documents stored reliably in Firestore.

/chat_files/{fileId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Base64 file chunks for reliable signed-in Mchart downloads without HTTP 401 errors.
